description: This Java class `OrderProductDownloadUrlTag` is a custom JSP tag that generates a download URL for an order product, utilizing store and request information.

classes.name: OrderProductDownloadUrlTag
classes.description: Custom JSP tag class that constructs a product download URL based on store and order details.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates and outputs the download URL for an order product, handling exceptions and logging errors.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Ends tag processing and continues with page evaluation.

methods.name: getOrderId
methods.description: Getter for the order ID associated with the download.

methods.name: setOrderId
methods.description: Setter to assign an order ID for the download URL generation.
